citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 12:08pm on
06/17/2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee via a phone call and leaving a voicemail on arrival and upon
leaving the property, alerting a staff member from the licensee's nearby business, waiting 30minutes, and honking outside
the facility. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and
regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
